;Armed conflicts and attacks
*The U.S. removes four [[MIM-104 Patriot|Patriot missile batteries]], two [[jet fighter]] squadrons and dozens of [[United States Armed Forces|military]] personnel from [[Saudi Arabia]] while considering a reduction in the [[U.S. Navy]] presence in the [[Persian Gulf]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-to-remove-patriot-missile-batteries-from-saudi-arabia-11588867916 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**[[Saudi Arabia]] withdraws its [[Saudi Arabian Army|troops]] from the [[Yemen]]i island of [[Socotra]] amid separatist unrest. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20200507-saudi-withdraws-its-troops-from-yemens-socotra/ (Middle East Monitor)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Visakhapatnam gas leak]]
**Eleven people die and over 5,000 fall ill from a [[styrene]] [[gas leak]] from an [[LG Chem|LG Polymers chemical]] plant in [[Visakhapatnam]] in [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]]. [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/75590112.cms (''Times of India'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***The [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[Jesuit]] community at [[Pickering, Ontario]] mourns the deaths of five members of their community, including four priests, who died of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] at the [[Religious order (Catholic)|religious order’s]] long-term care facility. [https://cruxnow.com/church-in-the-americas/2020/05/jesuits-in-canada-mourn-members-deaths-at-ontario-long-term-care-home/ (''Crux'')]

;International relations
*[[China–Indonesia relations]]
**[[Government of Indonesia|Indonesian]] Foreign Minister [[Retno Marsudi]] summons [[Ambassadors of China|Chinese Ambassador to Indonesia]] Xiao Qian to express concerns about the alleged [[human rights]] violation of [[Indonesians|Indonesian]] workers aboard Chinese fishing vessels. This comes after a video showing Chinese sailors throwing the body of a dead Indonesian crew member overboard went viral. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/05/07/indonesian-sailors-deaths-on-chinese-fishing-vessel-raise-questions-about-working-conditions.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Shooting of Ahmaud Arbery]]
**Gregory and Travis McMichael are arrested for [[murder (United States law)|murder]] and [[aggravated assault]] in relation to the February shooting of an [[African American]] man in [[Brunswick, Georgia]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/mother-unarmed-black-man-killed-georgia-speaks-ahmaud/story?id=70552216 (ABC News)]
*[[Lesotho|Lesothan]] [[King of Lesotho|King]] [[Letsie III]] approves a law barring [[Prime Minister of Lesotho|Prime Minister]] [[Tom Thabane]] from dissolving parliament and calling an election in the event of a [[Motion of no confidence|vote of no confidence]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesothos-king-assents-to-bill-limiting-pm-thabanes-powers-idUSKBN22J2UD?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Criminal charges brought in the Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**The [[U.S. Department of Justice]] drops its prosecution of [[Michael Flynn]] for [[lying to the FBI]]. He previously [[Timeline of investigations into Donald Trump and Russia (July–December 2017)#20171201|pleaded guilty]] to the charges during [[Mueller special counsel investigation|the investigation led by Robert Mueller]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2020/05/07/top-prosecutor-in-flynn-case-abruptly-withdraws-amid-trump-attacks-243107 (''Politico'')]
